method: cargo feature ablation, gzip -9 -c, same source both sides, same rustc 1.91.1 and wasm-opt 131
caveat: The gzipped delta is NEGATIVE, which is not a saving: it is the noise floor. Sub-kilobyte deltas on a 420 KB artifact are not trustworthy (the spike measured the same feature at 238 bytes in one run and 439 in another). Report as: a few hundred bytes uncompressed, nothing measurable compressed. The three revm CfgEnv fields the feature adds are `false` by default and revm's is_*_disabled() accessors return the same values as when the fields do not exist, so the behavioural cost is zero and the recorded corpus is byte-identical.
